content.answer: When updating an id-referenced single-select catalog, merge options by stable id rather than rebuilding by name: pass every existing option object through unchanged (its name keeps its old id), assign fresh ids only to genuinely new names, numbering them from max(existing id)+1 — rebuilding the option list from names alone makes the API regenerate all ids and silently clears every existing row's reference.
content.reuse_advice: For any update to an id-referenced catalog (single-select/multi-select options, tags, categories, etc.): never send a name-only list that overwrites the catalog. Always diff against the current catalog and merge — keep existing entries' ids untouched by passing the original objects through (only editing the name if needed), add only truly new entries with fresh ids continuing from max(existing id)+1, and explicitly delete only entries confirmed obsolete. Rebuilding by name resets ids and silently breaks all existing references.
